decision_rule_reachability.reason: All four decision labels (ROBUST, PARTIAL, COLLAPSED, MEASUREMENT_INVALID) are arithmetically reachable. The rule-level classifier classify_mem() verified branch inhabitancy over synthetic worlds (spec.design_satisfiability_probe.output.branch_reachability). ROBUST is reachable if B-MEMORY-RECEIPT recovers the binding imperfectly (rate < 0.95 with margin >= 0.05). PARTIAL is reachable and predicted: B-MEMORY-STATE and B-MEMORY-WINDOW-1@0.75 have margin 0.125/0.100 >= 0.05 with comp_rate < 0.95. COLLAPSED is reachable if even state-only memory closes the range. MEASUREMENT_INVALID is reachable via any V1-V8 gate failure. Precedence (MEASUREMENT_INVALID first, then ROBUST, PARTIAL, COLLAPSED) is free of shadowing. The identity disclosure (B-MEMORY-RECEIPT success- and counter-identical to T) is consistent with margin 0, which mem_certifies correctly rejects.

baseline_identifiability.reason: Treatment T-AMORTIZED-DISCOVERY is at 1.0 at all bands. The memoryless baseline B-COLD-RE-DERIVE is probe-measured at (K-1)/K (F1 0.875, F2 0.900), both strictly inside [0.80, 0.95), with margin 0.125/0.100 >= 0.05 and counter distinctness 2/4 (gate V8_m0_counter_distinctness). The memoryful ladder provides the discriminating signal: B-MEMORY-STATE and B-MEMORY-WINDOW-1@0.75 are rate-distinct from T (margin 0.125/0.100) and counter-distinct (repair_calls differs). B-MEMORY-WINDOW-1@0.50, B-MEMORY-WINDOW-2, and B-MEMORY-RECEIPT are predicted rate- and counter-identical to T (margin 0). This identity is explicitly disclosed as the substantive collapse mechanism (the substrate has a single success path), and the decision rule handles it correctly: mem_certifies requires a positive margin, so an identical comparator can never certify, making the PARTIAL branch observable via the weaker comparators that remain distinct. No ceiling/floor situation forces all arms identical at the scored bands.

control_sensitivity.reason: Every control was probe-measured away from its boundary and can fail under the same implementation that scores the experiment. NC-MECHANISM-OFF raises cold to 1.0 and destroys the predecessor certificate (mechanism_off_destroys_certificate=true). NC-MEMORY-OFF drives B-MEMORY-RECEIPT back to (K-1)/K (memory_off_matches_m0=true), isolating receipt retention as the cause. NC-REVEAL-ORDER-FLIPPED fails the chain at (K-1)/K (reveal_order_flipped_fails_chain=true), isolating the precursor reveal. NC-RETRIEVAL-REDUNDANT leaves full-memory rate at 1.0 (retrieval_redundant_no_gain=true), showing retrieval is inert. NC-CEILING-BAND yields all ten arms 1.0 at novelty 0.0. NC-WINDOW-MONOTONIC holds (window_monotonic=true). NC-BINDING-UNIQUENESS: 0/160 collisions. NC-NO-LEAK is a hard V3/F-LEAK gate (10/10 invariants clean). The lattice is sensitive to removal of the very memory it measures.

nonblocking_findings.note: The PRIMARY comparator B-MEMORY-RECEIPT is predicted success- and counter-identical to the treatment (margin 0, 0/4 dimensions distinct). This is explicitly disclosed as the collapse mechanism, not an accidental identity. The decision rule correctly requires a positive margin for mem_certifies, so the identical comparator cannot certify, and the discriminating signal is carried by the weaker memoryful comparators (B-MEMORY-STATE, B-MEMORY-WINDOW-1@0.75) that remain rate- and counter-distinct. This design choice is scientifically sound and non-blocking.

ROBUST requires the full-receipt-memory comparator B-MEMORY-RECEIPT to mem_certify (rate < 0.95 with margin >= 0.05). Given the single-success-path substrate, this branch is arithmetically reachable but scientifically implausible under the frozen construction (it would require the precursor receipt to not disclose the binding). The design correctly treats this as a reachable but unlikely branch, and the PARTIAL prediction reflects the arithmetic certainty of the collapse.

rationale: All six satisfiability/identifiability checks pass. The decision rule has four reachable branches with correct precedence. All measurement prerequisites are satisfied by the frozen stdlib-only harness. Baselines are identifiable: the memoryless comparator is in-band with margin >= 0.05 and counter distinctness 2/4; the memoryful ladder provides the discriminating signal via weaker comparators while the primary comparator's identity with treatment is the measured collapse mechanism. Controls are sensitive and probe-verified. Treatment is live at 1.0 across all bands. No mutable external artifacts exist; the harness is frozen in prereg/spec. The experiment is capable of answering its question and should proceed to freeze.
